coverage: Catalogue: hold synchronization, switch A to B/logout/dispose then release; no old snapshot or DB mutation applied

Analysis: hold actual multipart client response, then switch/logout/dispose. Test success, rejected-image, nonretryable API failure and retryable failure. Assert actual target row entered analyzing and is unchanged after obsolete result
Positive current-account controls preserve normal success, rejection, API-error and retry state transitions
Chat: delayed history and event after switch/logout/dispose produce no old-account messages or optimistic entries
Inbox: delayed snapshot after clear/logout/dispose cannot overwrite current items or notify after invalidation
Quintal: delayed load and command responses after switch/logout/dispose cannot change stock/cache; existing queue, reward and account regressions pass

findings.problem: HabitatService.load applied an async response and notified after disposal
findings.change: Check disposal and captured owner after asynchronous boundaries; stale loads do not alter error/loading state or notify

findings.problem: Rejected analysis response after account change/logout/disposal still wrote failure state to cache/database
findings.change: Apply current-photo/lifecycle guard to rejected and nonretryable analysis errors, matching successful-result behavior

executor: flutter test --no-pub --concurrency 1 --reporter json test/account_scope_races_test.dart test/quintal_production_service_test.dart test/conversation_controller_test.dart test/notification_store_test.dart
static_analysis: No issues found in both corrected product files and directed test files
limitations: Desktop Flutter component tests, own temporary SQLite and controlled HTTP responses, not physical Android/FCM or end-to-end latency evidence.

RES03-scope-01 had a fixture compile error; scope-02 shared old fixture rows and is excluded from approval. Scope-03 cleared rows per case and asserted the intended request/row before exposing 3 failures.
First confirmatory launcher failed setup before executing Flutter; retained as -01. Final -02 evaluated the published commit and verified source hashes unchanged.
Chat wire-envelope correctness is a separate DATA-08 finding; this closure validates account/lifecycle isolation and does not approve that contract.
